methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched from official vendor pricing pages via WebFetch on 2026-06-14 and adversarially re-verified. Otter.ai, Rev, Sonix, Descript, and Fireflies.ai pricing was read directly from official pages (all returned live HTML). VERIFICATION CORRECTIONS (2026-06-14): (1) Otter Pro annual rate corrected $8.33 -> $8.49/user/month (annualDiscountPct 51 -> 50) to match the official pricing page; some third-party aggregators still list $8.33. (2) Trint Starter monthlyUsd set to null: the GetApp $15/user/month figure is stale and contradicted by current sources indicating ~$80/seat/month, and no exact self-serve price is confirmable (official page JS-renders). (3) Notta Business corrected $59 -> $27.99/seat/month (the $59 aggregator figure was stale/incorrect; current source confirms $27.99 month-to-month, $16.67 annual); Notta Premium $13.99 confirmed against the same current source. HappyScribe publishes pricing exclusively in EUR with no USD equivalent and was excluded. monthlyUsd for annually-billed plans is the per-month rate derived from the annual total. annualDiscountPct is calculated from published monthly vs. annual-monthly rates. All minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall fields are null (non-telephony services). setupFeeUsd not applicable to any vendor in this category.
